Definition: from G3361 and G2089; no further:--any longer, (not) henceforth, hereafter, no henceforward (longer, more, soon), not any more.
BiblicalUsage: Meketi means no longer, not henceforth, and it draws the line between the old life and the new. 1 Peter 4:2 says the believer should no longer live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God. 1 Thessalonians 3:1 has Paul say he could no longer forbear, and so sent Timothy to the Thessalonians.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that 'no longer' is the gospel in two words: the old master has lost his claim.
